# h3_ovn_network (Resource)

**Deprecated:** use `h3_network`; this alias is removed in 1.0. Manages a subnet with its NAT gateway in the project VPC. Every argument change replaces the network (the API has no update). Place a VM in it with `h3_vm.subnet_name = h3_network.<name>.subnet_name`. `external_subnets` is not returned by the API (not checked for drift, empty after import).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr_block` (String) CIDR block (e.g. `10.1.0.0/24`)
- `name` (String) Network name

### Optional

- `external_subnets` (List of String) External subnets of the NAT gateway (optional)
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the network.
- `protocol` (String) IP protocol: `IPv4` (default), `IPv6` or `Dual`
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (`h3_vpc.<name>.id`); the project VPC when omitted

### Read-Only

- `gateway_id` (String) NAT gateway ID
- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway IP address in the subnet
- `gateway_name` (String) NAT gateway name in the platform
- `id` (String) Network (subnet) ID; same as `subnet_id`
- `status` (String) Network status (`CREATING`, `ACTIVE`)
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID
- `subnet_name` (String) Subnet name in the platform; pass it to `h3_vm.subnet_name`
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name in the platform
